integrity: The proof derives the complete element-order distribution from the fixed-point-free action, uses Frobenius orbits to prove q divides p^r-1, and then obtains an exact gcd obstruction. Bounded finite enumeration is used only as an independent replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats Frobenius groups with elementary abelian kernel of rank at least two and prime complement.
It does not settle the existence of nonabelian psi-divisible groups in general.
Larger complements and non-elementary Frobenius kernels require different element-order analysis.
An equivalent obstruction could exist under alternate Frobenius-group notation or in unindexed literature.
title: Prime-complement Frobenius groups with elementary abelian kernels are not psi-divisible
